subject: Alignment Beacon: weekly leadership spotlight + QBR prep
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Leadership Distribution List <leadership@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Alignment Beacon: weekly leadership spotlight + QBR prep

Team — quick pulse ahead of this week's QBR rehearsal. Attaching a compact OKR snapshot and the current QBR runbook (draft). High-level summary below (wins / risks / asks). Please flag anything incorrect or missing.

Wins
- Model serving throughput: Dedicated pool 3 is sustaining 95% of target RPS after autoscaling tweak (infra).
- Cost per 1k tokens down 12% MoM from optimizer rollout (infra + rt).
- Customer early adopter: Nimbus Analytics went live with Redwood Dedicated preview; initial latency metrics match our SLOs.

Risks
- Quantization regression: small but measurable BLEU-like drop on a subset of long-context tests after v2 quant profile. Cause unknown; affects 2 mid-account workloads.
- QBR slide gap: we still need a concise performance vs cost narrative and one customer quote for the deck.
- Rehearsal availability: only 2 of 4 presenters confirmed for Thursday run (conflict with air-gapped deployment dry-run).

Asks (owners / ETA)
1) Karthik — prioritize a quick A/B on the quant profile with fallback to v1 for impacted accounts; can we have a canary by Wed EOD?
2) Kimberly — lead a 30-minute dry-run to tighten the deck story; propose Thu 10:00-10:30 PT for rehearsal. Can you own?
3) Laura — secure a short customer quote from Nimbus or provide permission to use internal telemetry as interim. Needed by Wed noon.
4) Jonas/Neha — decision on whether to push the Dedicated capacity note into the product appendix or call it out as a headline. Need call by Wed COB.

Attachments: 2027_Q2_OKR_snapshot.xlsx (OKR progress tab + sprint-level notes), QBR_runbook-draft-v0.3.pdf (agenda and speaker notes).

Drive links and the draft deck are in the thread links above.

Thanks — short replies suffice for confirmations.

— Mateo Alvarez
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Leadership Distribution List <leadership@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alignment Beacon: weekly leadership spotlight + QBR prep

Thanks Mateo — helpful framing.
Quick notes:
- I'll pull the performance vs cost narrative into 2 slides (topline + appendix) and circulate a 1-paragraph blurb for the presenter notes by Tue COB.
- On the Nimbus quote, I'll reach out to their CSM now; if we don't have permission, we can use the latency chart + anonymized snippet.

Confirm Kimberly for Thu 10:00 for a focused run + I'll attend the first 15 to set the narrative.

Laura
Chief of Staff
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Leadership Distribution List <leadership@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Alignment Beacon: weekly leadership spotlight + QBR prep

On Mon, Apr 26, 2027 at 9:05 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Risks
> - Quantization regression: small but measurable BLEU-like drop on a subset of long-context tests after v2 quant profile. Cause unknown; affects 2 mid-account workloads.

I'll own the canary. Plan: roll v1/v2 side-by-side on a 10% traffic split for the two affected accounts and run a fixed eval suite (long-context summarization + consistency checks). If we see >3% degradation on the key evals, we'll rollback and keep v1 as the default.
Need infra-side permission to open the canary window (Dedicated pool 3) — Mateo, can infra allow a 90-minute canary tomorrow morning?

Also, quick ask: if we do fallback, do we need a customer communication plan or can we quietly fail over and fix before proactive outreach? My preference: quiet failover unless Nimbus sees an impact.

— Karthik
Director, Applied ML — Serving
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

- Thu 10:00-10:30 PT — full deck dry-run (15 min presentation + 15 min feedback).
- Prework: please add speaker lines in the runbook under your name by Wed noon (I highlighted the slide owners in the shared doc).
- I'll consolidate a 2-slide performance vs cost narrative with Laura's paragraph.

Also tagging Jonas: I'll need a short call with you Wed 4pm PT to confirm the Dedicated capacity wording (headline vs appendix).

Attachment: QBR_runbook-draft-v0.3.pdf (I added a rehearsal checklist).

Kimberly Park

- Call out Dedicated capacity as a headline — it's a competitive differentiator and the Nimbus pilot gives us a concrete example.
- Mateo — give Karthik the canary window. Prefer quiet failover but keep CSMs on standby.

I'll join the Wed 4pm slot if needed and will scan the deck before Thu.
